steps.content: Cold, silence, darkness. It takes you a long time to realize that the face before you belongs to a familiar woman.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Even for a dead person, you look miserable.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: It's still alive. After you provoked it, it got back all its power and wants a fight to the death.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Soon, many lives will be lost again.
You want to lift your hand, but your body won't oblige. You want to speak, but blood clogs your throat. Pain has left you, and soon this body will too. You finally understand why she has come to you.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Almost, seeing that you're back at my side. We've finally found the possibility to defeat it, after so many people sacrificed their lives to protect you. Yet you've arrived here, at last.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Saving the day, then sacrificing yourself. You've glorified yourself with death. Now, the whole Drifter Camp sees you as their hero... Are you happy?

steps.speaker: Options
options: ...Cut it out. I didn't do it on purpose.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I didn't plan to die... I did enough preparation. I was confident I could win, but I didn't expect something like that could happen.
Those blue shackles emerged at the touch of the Corpus. Was that a backfire of your power? Was it a poisonous trap buried in the Corpseborne by Parma? Or...?
No matter what it is, you could neither see through it nor avoid it. Death is ubiquitous indeed. You can't hide from it.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: You seem a little perplexed. Do you regret it?

You never thought the death warning she once gave you would come true like this. You can't go back now. No matter how mad and heartbroken they'll be, how much more danger they'll face, you can't do anything for them anymore.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But somehow, it doesn't hurt as much as I thought it would.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Hmph?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: <size=32>You said you would make the wishes of the dead come true. Now I can understand... Whether my soul will continue to exist after death, whether you will keep your promise, hearing that alone is enough to free me from the powerlessness at the end of life.</size>

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Thank you. You're very kind to the deceased.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So... Please make my wish come true. Destroy it in my stead.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't let it crawl back from hell. If I die, it must die with me.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: ...Hmph, is that how you take advantage of others' kindness?

steps.speaker: Options
options: You know me. There are too many things I can't let go of.

steps.content: She smiles.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: The gentle, kind Chief... I wish they could see you now.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: If devils did exist in this world, I suppose they would be as stubborn and shameless as you...
She stoops down and scoops up the blue pendant hanging in front of your chest.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Many people once sacrificed their lives to bring you back. I granted their wish, and I advised you to cherish your life.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: But if you ask me, I'd rather you, who also carries a dying wish, find relief.
"Many people"...?
Before you can ask, she raises a hand to caress your cheek, and her gaze lifts to meet yours. Her voice is eerie, as if touching your bare soul.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: I can grant your dying wish, just so you can be in peace and let go of all your regrets when you leave. I hope you can escape your destined misery... What do you think?

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Captain
Your consciousness is falling apart. This is the final question and answer. You try hard to consolidate your diffusing thoughts, and part your lips instinctively.

steps.speaker: Options
options: I want to live, of course.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know this answer disappoints you... You're always forced to help a stubborn living person. I know you're not comfortable with it, and you're not willing to do it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But if I die just like this, won't it be boring for you...? If it so happens, I can only share my pain and regret with you after death. You said you didn't want to hear that.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: ...Which means?

steps.speaker: Options
options: How about we strike a deal?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I want neither to embrace nor escape from death. Perhaps I've never pondered death seriously... because I cherish life. While I'm still alive, I want to dedicate all I have to fighting for what I want and protecting what I love.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If I'm bound to return to you when I die... then please, help me this time while I'm still alive. Not to grant a dying wish, but just so I can...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Bring you more when I die, after I've lived hard.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: ...Do you have any idea what you're talking about? Do you think you can just bribe me like this?
She suddenly cups your face with her hands and looks into your eyes. Those two eyes of different colors, like life and death, are suddenly brimming with smile, looking almost greedy and hysterical.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: I can! I can break the rules for you, and accept the guidance of the living. In exchange, the price you pay is that after you are truly dead, everything will belong to me.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: I want to hear some last words that aren't about pain or regret. I've heard too much already.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Bring me a more interesting death. From this day onwards, this is what you live for. Your death now belongs to me, and so does your life!
This madness makes you shiver. She never wanted a selfless giver. She's a maniac who's obsessed with the realm of death. You have no other choices, and this is in fact what you need.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Hahahaha... Very well... That's a promise of life and death. No one can break it.
You begin to hear the sound of suona as pain strikes you. Proof that you're alive.

The figure before you begins contorting and fading. That distant female voice grows louder and solid beside your ear. Somebody is supporting you. Somebody is confronting the strong enemy. She seems to be in a good mood, filled with joy.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: To me, the living world is total chaos. Since you can see the path ahead, be my eyes, guide me.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Now, tell me. Where is that enemy you want to destroy even at the cost of your life...?
Your hand no longer obeys you, but the shackles stretch forward eagerly...

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Good job, you did well...
Bang! Bang bang!!

steps.speaker: Corpseborne?
steps.content: Ahhh!!

<size=32>Cries pour down from above. A certain being struggles and fails, wrecking the truss bridge of the camp, scraping off numerous walls and broken tiles. The enormous being falls to the bottom of the camp. Amid smoke and debris, it can no longer conceal itself.</size>

steps.speaker: Corpseborne?
steps.content: How dare you... How dare you...!!
Oak Casket lays you flat on the ground and takes a step forward toward that gradually emerging Corpus, holding two guns glimmering with an icy light. Her voice is compassionate and maniacal.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Half of your body and soul have already sunk into the abyss, into eternal slumber. Why must you struggle to live miserably alone? Isn't that torture?

steps.speaker: Corpseborne?
steps.content: Roar!!! Shut up!! I won't die, I must live!!

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Poor child... You need someone to set you free.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: I'll send you home now.
